2cae0cef-d229-4691-bd83-936d4e90dc46.title: Library Management System
2cae0cef-d229-4691-bd83-936d4e90dc46.original_text: The Member clicks the log-in button on the Home Page. The system displays the log- in page. The member enters his login Id with password. The member clicks on the confirm button. The system checks that all of the required information was entered. If the entered information is wrong then system asks member to reenter the details. The system validates the entered information against the tables stored in the database. Member must be logged in to the system. The member clicks on View user details. The system opens a page showing the details of the member. The details include the total number of issued books, date of issue, return date, fine to be paid. The member closes the page. The system shows OK message. The books should be stored in database. The books must be ready to retrieve. The system asks user to login. The system identifies the type of user- member, guest or administrator. The system shows the categories to browse. The user selects a category of books to view. If no category is selected by the user then the system again asks user to select a category. The system checks the books in the database. The system retrieves all the books falling in that category. The user selects the desired books. The system shows the details of the selected books. The system asks user to print the details. If User does not want to print the details then user can ignore the step. User can reserve a book by inputting the relevant details & the librarian can also reserve a book for a member. User should be logged into the system. User should have correct book Id. Books should be available to reserve. The system asks user to login. The system identifies the type of user- member, guest or administrator. The system shows the categories to browse. The user selects book to reserve. If no book is selected by the user then the system again asks user to select a book to reserve. The user enters Book Id to reserve. If the book Id is wrong then system asks user to recheck the book id. The system checks the books in the database. If the selected book is already reserved on another Id then system asks user to select another book. Members should be logged into the system. Guest user can also search books. Book should be available to search. The system shows the categories to browse. The member selects a category of searching a book. If no category is selected by the member then the system again asks user to select a category. The system checks the books in the database. The system retrieves all the books falling in that category. Member should give the member Id to the librarian. Books should be available to issue. The librarian Checks the availability of the books. The librarian also checks total number of books issued on that Id. Librarian issues the book. The librarian cannot issue the books if the user has three books issued on his Id. The system updates the information in database. Librarian should be logged into the system. Member should have borrowed books. Member should give the member Id to the librarian. The member returns the book. The librarian enters book id , member id in the system. If the entered book id is incorrect then system asks to re-enter the book id. The system prompts a message that the book with book id is successfully returned. Members should be stored in the database. Members should be available to retrieve by the system. Member must be logged in to the system. Guest can also view members. The user clicks on View members. The system opens a page showing the details of the member. The details include name of member, the total number of issued books, date of issue, return date, fine to be paid. The member closes the page. Librarian should be logged into the system. Books should be available to remove. Book details should be available to add or remove books in the database. The librarian has option of adding or removing a book in database. The system asks librarian to add or remove the book. The librarian adds a book. The system asks librarian to enter all the required details about the new book to be added. The librarian enters the details. If the librarian selects to remove a book then the book should be outdated. The system administrator that all the information has been correctly provided. Administrator should be logged into the system. Member should be available to remove. Member details should be available to add or remove member in the database. The system asks administrator to add or remove a member. The administrator selects to add a member. The system asks administrator to enter all the required details about the new member to be added. The administrator enters the details. If the administrator selects to remove a member then a valid reason of removal is required. The system validates that all the information has been correctly provided.

5. If required login information is missing, then the system shall be able to prompt the user to enter the missing information.
6. The system shall be able to validate entered login credentials against the database.
7. If the entered login credentials are incorrect, then the system shall be able to prompt the user to re-enter the details.
8. If the entered login credentials are correct, then the system shall be able to log the user into the system.
9. The system shall be able to identify the type of user upon login as member, guest, or administrator.
10. The system shall provide the ability to display categories of books to browse after login.
11. The system shall provide the ability to select a category of books to view.
12. If no category is selected, then the system shall be able to prompt the user to select a category.
13. The system shall be able to check the books available in the database for the selected category.
14. The system shall be able to retrieve all books falling in the selected category from the database.
15. The system shall provide the ability to select one or more books from the displayed list.
16. The system shall be able to display the details of the selected books.
17. The system shall provide the ability to prompt the user to print the details of the selected books.
18. If the user does not want to print the details, then the system shall allow the user to ignore the print step.
19. The system shall provide the ability to reserve a book by entering relevant details.
20. The system shall provide the ability for a librarian to reserve a book for a member.
21. The system shall require the user to be logged in to reserve a book.
22. The system shall require the user to enter a valid Book ID to reserve a book.
23. The system shall be able to check the availability of books for reservation in the database.
24. If the Book ID entered is incorrect, then the system shall be able to prompt the user to recheck the Book ID.
25. If the selected book is already reserved on another ID, then the system shall be able to prompt the user to select another book.
26. The system shall provide the ability for guest users to search for books.
27. The system shall be able to check that books are available to search in the database.
28. The system shall provide the ability to display categories to browse for searching books.
29. The system shall provide the ability for members to select a category when searching for a book.
30. If no category is selected by the member, then the system shall prompt the user to select a category.
31. The system shall be able to retrieve all books in the selected category for searching.
32. The system shall require the member to provide their member ID to the librarian for book issuing.
33. The system shall be able to check the availability of books for issuing in the database.
34. The system shall be able to check the total number of books issued on a member ID.
35. The system shall provide the ability for the librarian to issue a book to a member.
36. If the member has three books already issued on their ID, then the system shall prevent the librarian from issuing additional books.
37. The system shall be able to update the database after a book is issued.
38. The system shall require the librarian to be logged in to issue a book.
39. The system shall require the member to have borrowed books in order to return them.
40. The system shall require the member to provide their member ID to the librarian for book return.
41. The system shall provide the ability for the member to return a book.

43. If the entered Book ID is incorrect during return, then the system shall prompt for re-entry of the Book ID.
44. The system shall be able to prompt a message that the book with the given Book ID has been successfully returned.

46. The system shall be able to retrieve member information from the database.

52. The system shall provide the ability for guests to view member details.
53. The system shall provide the ability for the user to click on "View members."
54. The system shall be able to display the name of the member, total number of issued books, date of issue, return date, and fine to be paid on the members page.
